title: Central Texas Harley & Plains Loop
summary: A 77.6-mile loop from Liberty Hill to Central Texas Harley-Davidson in Round Rock, returning across the Williamson County plains via Taylor and Granger.
body_markdown: Start at the US 183 and TX-29 crossing in Liberty Hill and head south through Leander and Cedar Park to Round Rock via US 183, E New Hope Drive, Ronald Reagan Boulevard, and RM 1431 / University Boulevard. After stopping at Central Texas Harley-Davidson off N Mays Street and the I-35 frontage road, head east on University Boulevard and Chandler Road to TX-95 near Taylor, then loop back through Granger and Georgetown across the plains via TX-29, TX-130, TX-195, Ronald Reagan Boulevard, FM 3405, and US 183.

sources.title: Google Maps itinerary exported via Google Maps Extended Routes GPX

author_note.text: A nice ride from the TX-29 and US 183 crossing down to Central Texas Harley-Davidson to stretch my legs and explore the store, then back through the open plains landscape.

waypoints: E Whitestone Blvd at Ronald Reagan Blvd, Cedar Park
University Blvd at N Mays St, Round Rock
